name: Spacebot
description: Spacebot is a self-hosted AI agent for teams and communities that talks to many people at once on Discord, Slack, Telegram, email and its own web chat. Conversation, thinking and work run as separate processes, so the agent stays responsive while workers run shell, browser and coding tasks, and it keeps a shared memory graph, tasks and schedules in embedded databases.

notes.text: The web UI and API have no login. Anyone who reaches port 19898 controls the agent, which can run shell commands, so keep it on a trusted network or behind an authenticating reverse proxy.
Without a preset endpoint, add an LLM provider key under Settings in the web UI before the agent can reply.

app_vars.name: var_llm_base_url
app_vars.label: OpenAI-compatible Base URL
app_vars.help: Including /v1, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave empty to add a provider in the web UI

app_vars.name: var_llm_api_key
app_vars.label: LLM API Key
app_vars.help: Key for the base URL above, if the endpoint needs one

app_vars.name: var_llm_model
app_vars.label: LLM Model
app_vars.help: Model used by every agent process, required with the base URL
